title: Canonical affine edge on upper truncation
statement: Let f:X\to Y be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Write F for direct image to f_*\mathcal O_X-modules [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], with total right derived functor RF [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Assume derived categories on both module-sheaf categories and enough injectives on X. Let I be a cochain complex with quasi-coherent cohomology in every degree [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and n\in\mathbf Z. Write h for the chosen left homology data of I.sc(n), so h.K is cycles, h.fprime is the differential into cycles and h.pi is the homology projection. Let A=\tau_{\le n}I and let c:\operatorname{coker}(F(h.fprime))\to H^n(RF(QA)) be the composite of the canonical cokernel-to-homology isomorphism, the inverse of H^n(F(A\to I)), the localization homology comparison, and H^n of the derived unit at A [lem-sc-left-exact-upper-truncation-comparison]. There exists an isomorphism e:H^n(RF(QA))\to F(h.H) such that \operatorname{coker}\pi\,c\,e=F(h.pi). No K-injectivity or boundedness of I is assumed.

proof.text: On inverse images of affine opens, positive right-derived sections vanish on quasi-coherent modules by affine vanishing and the module/source comparison. Sections preserve countable products. Apply the unbounded bound with N=1 to tau<=n-1 I; derived sections vanish in degrees n and n+1. The truncation triangle gives H^n(RGamma(A)) isomorphic to H^n(RGamma(tau>=n A)).

The double truncation is H^n(I) placed in degree n. Single-object derived identification and the left-exact bottom comparison identify degree-n derived sections with sections of H^n(I). The maps commute with restriction and respect scalars, so glue over the affine basis to an isomorphism of direct-image-algebra module sheaves.

Apply naturality of the raw-to-derived unit to A -> tau>=n A. Its degree-n component is the quotient of cycles by boundaries. Invert the raw upper-truncation homology comparison. Kernel and cokernel uniqueness give the stated identity after the cokernel projection; these are precisely the factors defining upperTruncationBoundaryComparison.

theorem affine_algebra_upper_truncation_edge
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hI : ∀ n : ℤ, (I.homology n).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℤ) :
    let F := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)
    ∃ e : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))) n).obj
        (F.rightDerivedFunctor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (I.truncLE n))) ≅
        F.obj (I.sc n).homologyData.left.H,
      cokernel.π (F.map (I.sc n).homologyData.left.f') ≫
          F.upperTruncationBoundaryComparison I n ≫ e.hom =
        F.map (I.sc n).homologyData.left.π
